Nineteen comments

Miss Hamilton

The best of the best, how lucky we are that some of these old tunes still exist. This one is over three hundred years old but sounds as good today as it did then. What can I say this the only tune of Cornelius Lyons that survives. There is a deep spirituality in this tune.

↳ Posted by JACKB on January 31st, 2007.

Yes JACKB, it’s one of my favourites too, although I, like yourself I’m sure, of course play it at a lot slower pace than it comes flying out at you here!

Composed while he was in the service of Lord Antrim I believe, but then Cornelius wasn’t a County Antrim man born & bred, so is this a Co Antrim tune, or what, I wonder?

Who cares eh? ….. it’s just a beautiful tune - good onya Corne!

↳ Posted by Ptarmigan on February 19th, 2007.

“Miss Hamilton” ~ March ~ Cornelius Lyons

This can be played without repeats, AB, or with them, AABB, as notated here and by Edward Bunting. Edward Bunting attributes the composition of this march to Cornelius Lyons, 1680-1750, harper to the Earl of Antrim and friend of Turlough O’Carolan, 1670-1738.

“O’Neill’s Music of Ireland: 1850 Melodies” ~ Page 344, #1830

For more story:
The Fiddler’s Compaion
http://www.ibiblio.org/fiddlers/MISSG_MISSJO.htm

↳ Posted by ceolachan on February 19th, 2007.

Miss Hamilton, X:6

X6 is “Miss Hamilton’s Delight” from a manuscript dated 1700 in the National Library of Scotland. However, since Cornelius Lyons is said to have written “Miss Hamilton” in 1706, either that date is wrong, or the estimate of the date of the MS is out. Whichever, it must be one of the earliest appearances of the tune.

↳ Posted by Nigel Gatherer on November 17th, 2023.

Re: Miss Hamilton

Re my post above, it has been pointed out to me that the manuscript in question, rather than the library’s estimate of 1700, is more likely to date from post 1745. That makes more sense. The first published version of the tune is possibly McGibbon’s 1759 collection, where it’s called “Miss Hamilton’s Dilight”.

↳ Posted by Nigel Gatherer on November 17th, 2023.
